title: Qwen3 FP16 answer-boundary typed-edge coalition external validity
question: Does one artificial object-color scope in Qwen3-4B FP16 contain a sparse answer-boundary Q/OV/MLP coalition that specifically rescues and blocks an unseen counterfactual response?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Frozen answer-boundary q_proj, aggregated OV and MLP-write coalition rescue, wrong identity, matched null and reverse blocking on unseen worlds.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: The one-shot Qwen3 confirmation conjunction passes after behavior qualification and frozen discovery/selection.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: Behavior fails, or the frozen coalition fails any rescue, identity, null or reverse-block threshold.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: The same one-shot confirmation intervention battery.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: The micro-Transformer camera does not externally transfer to this Qwen3 scope, or produces nonselective activation replacement.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One base, target, wrong-identity and matched-null object-color quartet.

calibration.development: Tokenizer-only material qualification; no model development run.

data_contract.split_rule: Discovery ranks registered single components by correct rescue only; selection chooses a frozen prefix with the complete control battery; confirmation cannot select anything.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Base, target, wrong and null natural panels must each pass behavior before traces are captured.

metrics.estimator: Correct rescue cosine, relative error and projection.
Target response remaining after base-coalition restoration.

typed_gates.rule: Every panel accuracy is at least 0.90 and all candidate scores are finite.
Target norm, correct cosine, relative error and projection pass together.
Wrong identity and matched null pass together.
Reverse blocking leaves at most 0.50 of the target response.
authorizes: bidirectional causal candidate in this scope

budget.right_censoring_rule: No threshold change, prompt change, value deletion, layer-role rescan, prefix extension or confirmation reselection.

stopping_rules: Behavior failure stops before trace capture.
Pass or fail closes the local C006-C009 campaign.
No automatic GLM4, DS7B or second Qwen interface follows.
The selected prefix is sparse and sufficient under this intervention; it is not asserted unique or minimal.

adjudication.failure_claim: This registered Qwen3 scope did not satisfy the complete behavior, rescue, identity, null and reverse-block conjunction.
adjudication.reopen_condition: Only a separately motivated natural object or genuinely new intervention semantics may open a new campaign; this material, threshold and component search remain closed.

authorizes_on_pass: one Qwen3 artificial-scope sparse sufficient typed-coalition candidate
authorizes_on_failure: retain the frozen response atlas as a negative boundary
